title: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling in Apache James Mime4J library prior version 0.8.15 allows Denial…
description: A vulnerability in the Apache James Mime4J library prior to version 0.8.15 allows denial of service due to allocation of resources without limits or throttling when parsing MIME messages. The issue is fixed in version 0.8.15 by enforcing new limits and providing better defaults.
